name: Dot Matrix Controls
description: Three vertical dot-matrix sliders for brightness, volume and font size, drawn on canvas with pixel icons. Dragging changes the theme, label sizes and an ambient audio tone.
contents: Three draggable canvas dot-grid sliders with icons, labels and live values
Mode label in the corner and a faint dotted background pattern
behavior: Sliders animate in from zero to target values with a stagger
Drag or touch a slider to set its value
Brightness above 50 switches the scene to light mode
Font size slider scales all text
First pointer press starts a generated ambient sound or the provided audio, volume and brightness shape it
editableByProps: Dark and light colors, accent, dot and pattern colors
Grid density, dot size, start values, animation timing
All labels, font size steps, font family, optional audio file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the brightness threshold for light mode
needsCodeEdit.where: const light = bv > 50 in the sync function

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the JetBrains Mono font from Google Fonts through link tags
Adds window resize and document pointerdown listeners while mounted and removes them on unmount
Starts an Web Audio ambient tone on the first pointer press when no audioSrc is given
